sam: observed latency & bias with Mixtral-8B AWQ profile on long-rope inputs — Qwen seems fine. anyone seen head-wise softmax skew after calibrating with short-prompts? :thinking:

elaine: yep, saw similar. RoPE scale mismatch causing attenuation for positions >1024, token probs shift toward earlier tokens. trace attached.

vikram: from perf traces: kernel selector oscillates between `int8_awq_path` and `fp8_fallback` at seqlen ~512 depending on batch composition. throughput dips ~30% when it switches mid-batch. perf counters:
```
KS_SWITCHES=42
AVG_TOK_MS=1.84 -> 2.42
```

maya: interesting — also found KV cache warmup behaving weird: when prefix tokens come from calibration prompts the KV entries get duplicated across heads (looks like duplicate insert due to stride mismatch). simple repro: run 2x `--calib-prefix` with different prompt lengths and compare KV size.

perf-bot: perf artifact uploaded: https://perf.internal/reports/2065178910/mixtral-awq-rope-bias

elaine: quick experiment: priming warmup helped. run `./bin/priming --model mixtral-8b --prefix-length 32 --mode kv-warm` before serving; p99 down ~8% and bias reduced on our eval set.

sam: can we add a focused regression test (calib prompts + long-rope eval) to the nightly matrix? @elaine @vikram please pair on thresholds. I'll open an RFC for deterministic kernel thresholding.

vikram: adding note — avoid hysteresis by making kernel selection sticky per-request if seqlen changes <= 64 tokens; reduces churn in A/B tests. rough patch next.

maya: logging: I'll add KV size diff and kernel id to the trace header so we can bisect.

sam: thanks, team. keeping this thread as the ground truth for followups :sparkles:
